description: Local (run_evals.ts) run of the hybrid suite against the deployed NextBillion MCP server.

cases.title: Autocomplete Google Amphitheatre address prefix
cases.name: autocomplete
cases.prompt: I am typing 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy into the search bar. Show autocomplete candidates for the prefix '1600 Amphitheatre Pkw'.

cases.title: Autocomplete 'stat' prefix near Oklahoma City restricted to USA
cases.name: autocomplete
cases.description: Autocomplete 'stat' prefix near Oklahoma City restricted to USA
cases.prompt: Complete the partial address prefix 'stat' near latitude 35.4769, longitude -97.4872 restricted to country USA.

cases.title: Autosuggest misspelled aquarium query
cases.name: autosuggest
cases.prompt: I made a typo while searching. Suggest places for the misspelled query 'aqauriums' near latitude 42.3501 and longitude -71.0689.
cases.passCriteria: Calls autosuggest (the model may correct the typo, so query is not asserted)

cases.title: Autosuggest partial tourist query
cases.name: autosuggest
cases.prompt: Find search-as-you-type suggestions for the incomplete query 'London muse' near latitude 51.5074, longitude -0.1278.

cases.title: Geocode 10 Downing Street address
cases.name: geocode_forward

cases.title: Geocode White House with USA country filter
cases.name: geocode_forward
cases.description: Geocode White House with USA country filter
cases.prompt: Find the coordinates of '1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington DC', restricted to country USA.

cases.title: Reverse geocode Paris coordinates
cases.name: geocode_reverse
cases.prompt: What address is at latitude 48.8566, longitude 2.3522?

cases.title: Reverse geocode Berlin coordinates
cases.name: geocode_reverse
cases.prompt: Reverse geocode latitude 52.5200, longitude 13.4050 and tell me the city.

cases.title: Structured geocode 221B Baker Street London
cases.name: geocode_structured

cases.title: Structured geocode Mullen Ave San Francisco
cases.name: geocode_structured

cases.title: Batch geocode US landmarks
cases.name: geocode_batch

cases.title: Search coffee shops near location

cases.title: Search hospitals within a circle in Berlin

cases.title: Lookup postal code SW1A 1AA UK
cases.name: geocode_postcode
cases.prompt: Find the location of the UK postcode SW1A 1AA.

cases.title: Directions SF to LA avoiding tolls
cases.name: get_directions
cases.description: Directions SF to LA avoiding tolls

cases.title: Truck directions with weight and hazmat
cases.name: get_directions

cases.title: Distance matrix Singapore 1x2
cases.name: distance_matrix
cases.prompt: Compute a distance matrix from origin (1.3521, 103.8198) to destinations (1.2897, 103.8501) and (1.3644, 103.9915).

cases.name: distance_matrix

cases.title: Isochrone 10 and 20 minute driving contours

cases.title: Isochrone 5-minute walking polygon
cases.name: isochrone
